structured.answer: Option 1, the one that starts with the S&P 500 group and puts the company name on top. It's the only one where I found my S&P track straight away, with fee and return next to it (Menora 0.52%, 13.79% over 3 years). I'd probably go Menora.

stuck.where: Option tabs at top, 'מומלץ' on option 3
stuck.why: The recommended tag pulled me toward option 3 even though option 1 already had what I wanted
I had to scroll through every Harel track, then every Mor track, to get past one S&P row. On a phone I'd have quit here
Wall of near-identical percentages in brown shades, no returns, column names I don't know. Nothing clicked
'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number for some funds. Didn't know if that's bad

used: Bold company names (מנורה מבטחים, הראל, מגדל, כלל, מיטב)
Option 3 grid heading 'כל החברות מול כל סוגי ההשקעה' and the S&P column
skimmed: Rest of the S&P group rows in option 1
Option 2 rows for הראל and מור
skipped: Explanatory grey text under the option tabs and under each table
unsure_meaning: Small clock icons next to numbers
Option 3 colours — guessed darker brown = more expensive
Which return matters more, 3 years or 5 years
not_found: What to do first / how to open one
Whether this is suitable for someone my age (קופת גמל להשקעה sounds like pension stuff)

findings.what: Three near-identical long tables stacked on one page; easy to lose which option you're in
Grouping by company buries the one S&P row under 15+ tracks per company; way too much scrolling on phone
Grid of 0.50–0.73% percentages all look the same and show no returns; recommended tag doesn't match what helped me
Fees only as small percentages, never in shekels, so the differences feel like nothing
Many funds show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return; unclear if bad
Unexplained ring icons, מט"ח, and the second 'מההפקדות' fee
Colour scale in grid not explained next to it; I had to guess darker = pricier
